incidents: the shared tmux session (main-repo git root) also hosted the concurrent coding-agent workspace agent's windows; killing my server windows on that shared session stopped their vite dev server (window 'workspace-launch', port 5181). Process-level interference only: their worktree, branch, and files were never touched. Disclosed to the owner; their agent can restart the server.
a stale preview server process survived one restart attempt (old module cache served a 500); resolved by killing the actual listening PID — no data impact.

two mid-proof platform fixes came out of the boundary evidence and were folded back into the templates before the final scaffold: the compiler consumes identity entries only (contracts.map/capabilities.map) and the generic host creates its .data directory.
